model_probability_notice: Win probability is not confidence in the research. Evidence coverage and model disagreement are separate diagnostics. No independently demonstrated accuracy improvement is claimed.
price_notice: Observed aggregator quotes, not confirmed executable offers. Field conflicts can mean stale pre-withdrawal prices or Rule 4 changes. Such races are blocked from the reviewed value list.
nonrunner_quote_policy: Rows explicitly marked NR are excluded even when the grid retains historical prices.
data_notice: Historical archive stops on 22 October. Career coverage is incomplete, including some overseas starts. Subsequent form uses only outcomes dated before 24 October.

reviewed_cases.why: Won a 16-runner Doncaster 5f handicap on 13 September off 85. Fourth at Haydock on Heavy, beaten 1.75 lengths by King Of Light, off 90. Now 89 and receives 8lb from that rival instead of 4lb. Both fixed component models estimate around 18–19%, against a 12.5% break-even chance at the observed 7/1.
reviewed_cases.risk: Only one matched Heavy start, 4lb above the Doncaster winning mark and several rivals with strong sprint form. The handicap comparison uses gross weights and does not establish the size of a true advantage.

reviewed_cases.why: Three Good-ground hurdle wins this year, including late progress to win over 2m4f at Worcester. Last time fourth of 15 there after staying on. Current card RPR 132 narrowly leads Newbrook Diamond's 131; both component models exceed the observed price's break-even probability.
reviewed_cases.risk: Moves up about 4f to near three miles. No matched start at this trip; Newbrook Diamond and Kashchei remain credible opposition. Components differ materially (about 49% versus 68%), so the ensemble's 59% is not high certainty.

reviewed_cases.why: Won the same Southwell sprint on 26 September off 84 in a nine-runner field, finishing from the rear, and has two course/trip wins in the matched record. Both component estimates (about 16–18%) exceed the 11.1% break-even probability at the observed 8/1.
reviewed_cases.risk: Now 87, a 3lb rise. Almaty Star is 7lb better off on gross weights than in their March Wolverhampton meeting, and Bona Fortuna and Night Storm provide strong opposition. Card TS/RPR also offer less support than the ensemble.

reviewed_cases.why: Four wins from six matched starts include a Newmarket 7f win and a Woodbine mile win; beaten only 0.6 lengths when third at Goodwood. Current card OR 112 and RPR 120 provide an ability case independently of favouritism. Both component models exceed the observed 10/1 break-even chance.
reviewed_cases.risk: No matched Heavy-ground start: much of the winning form is on Good to Firm/Firm. Earlier hanging and an unseating incident are material. Components differ (about 22% versus 37%); a large model/market gap could be model error rather than bookmaker error. This is a speculative case.

reviewed_rejections.reason: Strong conditions case, but the observed 7/2 requires a 22.2% chance against the frozen model's 17.2%. Neither component supports value at that quote.

5lb below the last winning AW handicap mark and 7lb better off against Moulin Booj than in March. The observed 10/1 still falls short of the model's 11.50 decimal break-even price; a plausible handicap angle does not by itself establish value.

The large model/price discrepancy needs caution: the latest two wins came in four-runner Class 4 hurdles. Today is a 19-runner Class 2 handicap off a mark 13lb higher. Stamina has evidence, but opposition and mark progression challenge the model estimate.
A three-runner Class 4 win follows defeats of 63.75 and 70.5 lengths in the matched history. The model ranks him first, but that alone does not justify a confident selection in this stronger race.
